comment: ball.c drag_ball() 839-840: a teleport that lands within chain range but must drag. A debug Valkyrie wishes a tree into the middle row of the room, steps west off it, reads a wished uncursed scroll of punishment (ball and chain on her square), walks two squares west so the chain lies west of the ball, and uses ^T with !tips to pick the square two east of the ball. teleds() calls drag_ball(); the ball is in range (distmin 2, case 4) but the chain's middle square is the tree, so SKIP_TO_DRAG reaches drag:, and the hero is more than one square from her old position, so ball and chain both go to the new square.
